                    </div>
                </td>
            <td style="text-align: left; white-space: nowrap;"><b>Elon Musk <span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:Twitter_Verified_Badge.svg" class="mw-file-description"><img src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e4/Twitter_Verified_Badge.svg/20px-Twitter_Verified_Badge.svg.png" decoding="async" width="15" height="15" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e4/Twitter_Verified_Badge.svg/40px-Twitter_Verified_Badge.svg.png 2x" data-file-width="512" data-file-height="512"></a></span></b> <div style="white-space: nowrap;"><style data-mw-deduplicate="TemplateStyles:r1152813436">.mw-parser-output .sr-only{border:0;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);clip-path:polygon(0px 0px,0px 0px,0px 0px);height:1px;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;padding:0;position:absolute;width:1px;white-space:nowrap}</style><span class="sr-only">(</span>@elonmusk<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only">)</span></div><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only"> tweeted:</span></td>
        </tr>
    </tbody></table>
    <blockquote style="text-align: left"><div style="margin:0.5em 0;padding:0">I made an offer<br><span class="url"><a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001418091/000110465922045641/tm2212748d1_sc13da.htm">https://sec.gov/Archives/edgar...</a></span></div></blockquote>
    <p style="margin:0;padding:0">April 14, 2022<sup id="cite_ref-180" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-180"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>176<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></p>
</div>
<p>In early 2017, Musk expressed interest in buying <a href="/wiki/Twitter,_Inc." title="Twitter, Inc.">Twitter</a> and had questioned the platform's commitment to <a href="/wiki/Freedom_of_speech" title="Freedom of speech">freedom of speech</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-181" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-181"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>177<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-182" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-182"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>178<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-183" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-183"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>179<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> By 2022, Musk had reached 9.2% stake in the company,<sup id="cite_ref-elder_184-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-elder-184"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>180<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> making him the largest shareholder.<sup id="cite_ref-Bloomberg4.14.22_185-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Bloomberg4.14.22-185"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>181<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-187" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-187"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>e<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk later agreed to a deal that would appoint him to Twitter's board of directors and prohibit him from acquiring more than 14.9% of the company.<sup id="cite_ref-188" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-188"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>183<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-189" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-189"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>184<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Days later, Musk made a $43 billion offer to buy Twitter.<sup id="cite_ref-Bloomberg4.14.22_185-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Bloomberg4.14.22-185"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>181<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-190" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-190"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>185<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> By the end of April Musk had successfully concluded his bid for approximately $44 billion.<sup id="cite_ref-191" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-191"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>186<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> This included approximately $12.5 billion in loans and $21 billion in <a href="/wiki/Equity_(finance)" title="Equity (finance)">equity financing</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-192" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-192"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>187<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-193" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-193"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>188<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Having backtracked on his initial decision,<sup id="cite_ref-194" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-194"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>189<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk bought the company on October 27, 2022.<sup id="cite_ref-deal_closed_195-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-deal_closed-195"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>190<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Immediately after <a href="/wiki/Acquisition_of_Twitter_by_Elon_Musk" title="Acquisition of Twitter by Elon Musk">the acquisition</a>, Musk fired several top Twitter executives including CEO <a href="/wiki/Parag_Agrawal" title="Parag Agrawal">Parag Agrawal</a>;<sup id="cite_ref-deal_closed_195-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-deal_closed-195"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>190<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-196" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-196"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>191<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk became the CEO instead.<sup id="cite_ref-197" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-197"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>192<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <a href="/wiki/Twitter_under_Elon_Musk" title="Twitter under Elon Musk">Under Elon Musk</a>, Twitter instituted monthly subscriptions for a "<a href="/wiki/Twitter_verification" class="mw-redirect" title="Twitter verification">blue check</a>",<sup id="cite_ref-198" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-198"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>193<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-199" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-199"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>194<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Binoy-2022_200-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Binoy-2022-200"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>195<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and laid off a significant portion of the company's staff.<sup id="cite_ref-201" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-201"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>196<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-202" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-202"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>197<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk lessened content moderation and hate speech also increased on the platform after his takeover.<sup id="cite_ref-Knight-2022_203-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Knight-2022-203"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>198<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-independent2023_204-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-independent2023-204"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>199<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Wapo_205-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wapo-205"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>200<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-206" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-206"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>201<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In late 2022, Musk released <a href="/wiki/Twitter_Files" title="Twitter Files">internal documents</a> relating to Twitter's moderation of <a href="/wiki/Hunter_Biden_laptop_controversy" title="Hunter Biden laptop controversy">Hunter Biden's laptop controversy</a> in the lead-up to the <a href="/wiki/2020_United_States_presidential_election" title="2020 United States presidential election">2020 presidential election</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-207" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-207"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>202<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk also promised to step down as CEO after a Twitter poll,<sup id="cite_ref-208" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-208"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>203<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-209" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-209"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>204<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and five months later, Musk stepped down as CEO and transitioned his role to <a href="/wiki/Chair_(officer)" title="Chair (officer)">executive chairman</a> and <a href="/wiki/Chief_technology_officer" title="Chief technology officer">chief technology officer</a> (CTO).<sup id="cite_ref-210" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-210"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>205<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Despite Musk stepping down as CEO, X continues to struggle with challenges such as viral <a href="/wiki/Misinformation" title="Misinformation">misinformation</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-211" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-211"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>206<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <a href="/wiki/Hate_speech" title="Hate speech">hate speech</a>, and <a href="/wiki/Antisemitism" title="Antisemitism">antisemitism</a> controversies.<sup id="cite_ref-212" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-212"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>207<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-213" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-213"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>208<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk has been accused of <a href="/wiki/Twitter_under_Elon_Musk#Lawsuits" title="Twitter under Elon Musk">trying to silence some of his critics</a> such as <a href="/wiki/Twitch_(service)" title="Twitch (service)">Twitch</a> streamer <a href="/wiki/Asmongold" title="Asmongold">Asmongold</a>, who criticized him during one of his streams.<sup id="cite_ref-free-speech_214-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-free-speech-214"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>209<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk has been accused of removing their accounts' <a href="/wiki/Twitter_verification" class="mw-redirect" title="Twitter verification">blue checkmarks</a>, which hinders visibility and is considered a form of <a href="/wiki/Shadow_banning" title="Shadow banning">shadow banning</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-215" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-215"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>210<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-216" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-216"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>211<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> or suspending their accounts without justification.<sup id="cite_ref-217" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-217"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>212<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Other_activities">Other activities</h2></div>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Hyperloop">Hyperloop</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main articles: <a href="/wiki/Hyperloop" title="Hyperloop">Hyperloop</a> and <a href="/wiki/Hyperloop_pod_competition" title="Hyperloop pod competition">Hyperloop pod competition</a></div>
<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/wiki/File:Hyperloop_pod_competition_tube.jpg" class="mw-file-description"><img alt="A long white tube about 10 feet in diameter" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/be/Hyperloop_pod_competition_tube.jpg/250px-Hyperloop_pod_competition_tube.jpg" decoding="async" width="250" height="167" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/be/Hyperloop_pod_competition_tube.jpg/500px-Hyperloop_pod_competition_tube.jpg 2x" data-file-width="3661" data-file-height="2441"></a><figcaption>A tube part of the 2017 Hyperloop pod competition, sponsored by SpaceX</figcaption></figure>
<p>In August 2013, Musk announced plans for a version of a <a href="/wiki/Vactrain" title="Vactrain">vactrain</a>, and assigned engineers from SpaceX and Tesla to design a transport system between <a href="/wiki/Greater_Los_Angeles" title="Greater Los Angeles">Greater Los Angeles</a> and the <a href="/wiki/San_Francisco_Bay_Area" title="San Francisco Bay Area">San Francisco Bay Area</a>, at an estimated cost of $6 billion.<sup id="cite_ref-218" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-218"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>213<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-219" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-219"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>214<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Later that year, Musk unveiled the concept, dubbed the <a href="/wiki/Hyperloop" title="Hyperloop">Hyperloop</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-220" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-220"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>215<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> intended to make travel cheaper than any other <a href="/wiki/Mode_of_transport" title="Mode of transport">mode of transport</a> for such long distances.<sup id="cite_ref-221" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-221"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>216<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="OpenAI_and_xAI">OpenAI and xAI</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main articles: <a href="/wiki/OpenAI" title="OpenAI">OpenAI</a> and <a href="/wiki/XAI_(company)" class="mw-redirect" title="XAI (company)">xAI (company)</a></div>
<p>In December 2015, Musk co-founded <a href="/wiki/OpenAI" title="OpenAI">OpenAI</a>, a <a href="/wiki/Nonprofit_corporation" title="Nonprofit corporation">not-for-profit</a> <a href="/wiki/Artificial_intelligence" title="Artificial intelligence">artificial intelligence</a> (AI) research company aiming to develop <a href="/wiki/Artificial_general_intelligence" title="Artificial general intelligence">artificial general intelligence</a>, intended to be safe and beneficial to humanity.<sup id="cite_ref-NYT_AI_222-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-NYT_AI-222"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>217<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk pledged $1 billion of funding to the company,<sup id="cite_ref-223" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-223"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>218<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> but only donated $50 million.<sup id="cite_ref-224" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-224"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>219<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2018, Musk left the OpenAI board.<sup id="cite_ref-225" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-225"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>220<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Since 2018, OpenAI has made significant advances in machine learning.<sup id="cite_ref-226" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-226"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>221<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In July 2023, Musk launched the artificial intelligence company <a href="/wiki/XAI_(company)" class="mw-redirect" title="XAI (company)">xAI</a>, which aims to develop a <a href="/wiki/Generative_artificial_intelligence" class="mw-redirect" title="Generative artificial intelligence">generative AI</a> program that competes with existing offerings like OpenAI's <a href="/wiki/ChatGPT" title="ChatGPT">ChatGPT</a>. Musk obtained funding from investors in SpaceX and Tesla,<sup id="cite_ref-227" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-227"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>222<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and xAI hired engineers from Google and OpenAI.<sup id="cite_ref-228" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-228"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>223<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Private_jet">Private jet</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main articles: <a href="/wiki/ElonJet" title="ElonJet">ElonJet</a> and <a href="/wiki/2022_Twitter_suspensions" class="mw-redirect" title="2022 Twitter suspensions">2022 Twitter suspensions</a></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1224211176"><div role="complementary" class="quotebox" style=";float:right;margin:.5em 0 .8em 1.4em;clear:right;width:220px">
    <table role="presentation" style="line-height: normal; width: 100%; background: transparent; color: inherit; display: table; margin: 0;">
        <tbody><tr>
            <td style="padding-right: 5px; width: 28px;">
                    <div style="height: 28px; width: 28px; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden;">
                        <figure class="mw-halign-center" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:Elon_Musk_Royal_Society_(crop2).jpg" class="mw-file-description" title="Avatar of Elon Musk"><img alt="Avatar of Elon Musk" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/34/Elon_Musk_Royal_Society_%28crop2%29.jpg/40px-Elon_Musk_Royal_Society_%28crop2%29.jpg" decoding="async" width="28" height="37" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/34/Elon_Musk_Royal_Society_%28crop2%29.jpg/60px-Elon_Musk_Royal_Society_%28crop2%29.jpg 2x" data-file-width="1337" data-file-height="1771"></a><figcaption>Avatar of Elon Musk</figcaption></figure>
                    </div>
                </td>
            <td style="text-align: left; white-space: nowrap;"><b>Elon Musk</b> <div style="white-space: nowrap;"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only">(</span>@elonmusk<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only">)</span></div><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only"> tweeted:</span></td>
        </tr>
    </tbody></table>
    <blockquote style="text-align: left"><div style="margin:0.5em 0;padding:0">Same doxxing rules apply to "journalists" as to everyone else</div></blockquote>
    <p style="margin:0;padding:0">December 16, 2022<sup id="cite_ref-229" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-229"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>224<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></p>
</div>
<p>Musk uses a private jet owned by Falcon Landing LLC, a SpaceX-linked company, and acquired a second jet in August 2020.<sup id="cite_ref-flight_230-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-flight-230"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>225<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-231" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-231"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>226<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> His heavy use of the jets and the consequent <a href="/wiki/Fossil_fuel" title="Fossil fuel">fossil fuel</a> usage have received criticism.<sup id="cite_ref-flight_230-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-flight-230"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>225<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-232" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-232"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>227<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk's flight usage is tracked on social media through <a href="/wiki/ElonJet" title="ElonJet">ElonJet</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-233" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-233"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>228<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-WP_234-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-WP-234"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>229<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Sky_235-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Sky-235"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>230<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In December 2022, Musk banned the ElonJet account on Twitter, and made temporary bans on the accounts of journalists that posted stories regarding the incident, including <a href="/wiki/Donie_O%27Sullivan_(journalist)" title="Donie O'Sullivan (journalist)">Donie O'Sullivan</a>, <a href="/wiki/Keith_Olbermann" title="Keith Olbermann">Keith Olbermann</a>, and journalists from <i><a href="/wiki/The_New_York_Times" title="The New York Times">The New York Times</a></i>, <i><a href="/wiki/The_Washington_Post" title="The Washington Post">The Washington Post</a></i>, CNN, and <i><a href="/wiki/The_Intercept" title="The Intercept">The Intercept</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-Taylor-2022_236-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Taylor-2022-236"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>231<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></i>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Grokipedia">Grokipedia</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <a href="/wiki/Grokipedia" title="Grokipedia">Grokipedia</a></div>
<p>In October 2025, Musk's company xAI launched Grokipedia, an AI-generated online encyclopedia that he promoted as an alternative to Wikipedia.<sup id="cite_ref-:11_237-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:11-237"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>232<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-238" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-238"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>233<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Articles on Grokipedia are generated and reviewed by xAI's <a href="/wiki/Grok_(chatbot)" title="Grok (chatbot)">Grok</a> chatbot.<sup id="cite_ref-239" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-239"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>234<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Media coverage and academic analysis described Grokipedia as frequently reusing Wikipedia content but framing contested political and social topics in line with Musk's own views and right-wing narratives. A study by Cornell University researchers and NBC News stated that Grokipedia cites sources that are blacklisted or considered "generally unreliable" on Wikipedia, for example, the conspiracy site <a href="/wiki/Infowars" title="Infowars">Infowars</a> and the neo-Nazi forum <a href="/wiki/Stormfront_(website)" title="Stormfront (website)">Stormfront</a>. <i><a href="/wiki/Wired_(magazine)" title="Wired (magazine)">Wired</a></i>, <i><a href="/wiki/The_Guardian" title="The Guardian">The Guardian</a></i> and <i><a href="/wiki/Time_(magazine)" title="Time (magazine)">Time</a></i> criticized Grokipedia for factual errors and for presenting Musk himself in unusually positive terms while downplaying controversies.<sup id="cite_ref-:11_237-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:11-237"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>232<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-240" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-240"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>235<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-241" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-241"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>236<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-242" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-242"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>237<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>

<p>Musk is an outlier among business leaders who typically avoid partisan political advocacy.<sup id="cite_ref-243" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-243"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>238<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-244" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-244"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>239<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-245" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-245"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>240<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk was a registered <a href="/wiki/Independent_voter" title="Independent voter">independent voter</a> when he lived in California.<sup id="cite_ref-NBCNewsMail_246-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-NBCNewsMail-246"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>241<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Historically, he has donated to both <a href="/wiki/Democratic_Party_(United_States)" title="Democratic Party (United States)">Democrats</a> and <a href="/wiki/Republican_Party_(United_States)" title="Republican Party (United States)">Republicans</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-huffingtonpost.com_247-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-huffingtonpost.com-247"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>242<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> many of whom serve in states in which he has a vested interest.<sup id="cite_ref-Peters-2022_248-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Peters-2022-248"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>243<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk supported Democrat <a href="/wiki/Barack_Obama" title="Barack Obama">Barack Obama</a> in <a href="/wiki/2008_US_presidential_election" class="mw-redirect" title="2008 US presidential election">2008</a> and <a href="/wiki/2012_United_States_presidential_election" title="2012 United States presidential election">2012</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-:0_249-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:0-249"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>244<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Democrat <a href="/wiki/Hillary_Clinton" title="Hillary Clinton">Hillary Clinton</a> in <a href="/wiki/2016_United_States_presidential_election" title="2016 United States presidential election">2016</a>, and Democrat <a href="/wiki/Joe_Biden" title="Joe Biden">Joe Biden</a> in <a href="/wiki/2020_United_States_presidential_election" title="2020 United States presidential election">2020</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-250" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-250"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>245<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In the <a href="/wiki/2020_Democratic_Party_presidential_primaries" title="2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries">2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries</a>, Musk endorsed candidate <a href="/wiki/Andrew_Yang" title="Andrew Yang">Andrew Yang</a> and expressed support for Yang's proposed <a href="/wiki/Universal_basic_income" title="Universal basic income">universal basic income</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-bloomberg.com_251-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-bloomberg.com-251"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>246<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and endorsed <a href="/wiki/Kanye_West" title="Kanye West">Kanye West</a>'s <a href="/wiki/Kanye_West_2020_presidential_campaign" class="mw-redirect" title="Kanye West 2020 presidential campaign">2020 presidential campaign</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-252" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-252"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>247<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>On August 5, 2021, Biden signed an <a href="/wiki/Executive_order" title="Executive order">Executive Order</a> targeting that half of cars sold in 2030 should be electric.<sup id="cite_ref-:2_253-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:2-253"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>248<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <a href="/wiki/General_Motors" title="General Motors">General Motors</a> CEO <a href="/wiki/Mary_Barra" title="Mary Barra">Mary Barra</a> was in attendance.<sup id="cite_ref-:2_253-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:2-253"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>248<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk commented, "seems odd that Tesla wasn't invited."<sup id="cite_ref-254" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-254"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>249<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Barra said in 2024 Musk never forgave not being invited.<sup id="cite_ref-255" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-255"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>250<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-256" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-256"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>251<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2025, former vice president <a href="/wiki/Kamala_Harris" title="Kamala Harris">Kamala Harris</a> said that she believed that not inviting Musk was a "big mistake."<sup id="cite_ref-257" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-257"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>252<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-258" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-258"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>253<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In September 2021, Musk criticized Biden as "not the friendliest administration."<sup id="cite_ref-259" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-259"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>254<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In December 2021, Musk publicly expressed opposition to the <a href="/wiki/Build_Back_Better_Act" title="Build Back Better Act">Build Back Better Act</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-260" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-260"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>255<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-261" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-261"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>256<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Since 2022, his political contributions have mostly supported Republicans, with his first vote for a Republican going to <a href="/wiki/Mayra_Flores" title="Mayra Flores">Mayra Flores</a> in the <a href="/wiki/2022_Texas%27s_34th_congressional_district_special_election" title="2022 Texas's 34th congressional district special election">2022 Texas's 34th congressional district special election</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-262" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-262"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>257<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-263" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-263"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>258<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2022, Musk gave over $50 million to <a href="/wiki/Citizens_for_Sanity" title="Citizens for Sanity">Citizens for Sanity</a>, a conservative <a href="/wiki/Political_action_committee" title="Political action committee">political action committee</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-mattioli_264-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-mattioli-264"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>259<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2023, he supported Republican <a href="/wiki/Ron_DeSantis" title="Ron DeSantis">Ron DeSantis</a> for the <a href="/wiki/2024_US_presidential_election" class="mw-redirect" title="2024 US presidential election">2024 U.S. presidential election</a>, giving $10 million to his campaign,<sup id="cite_ref-mattioli_264-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-mattioli-264"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>259<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and hosted DeSantis's campaign announcement on a <a href="/wiki/Twitter_Spaces" class="mw-redirect" title="Twitter Spaces">Twitter Spaces</a> event.<sup id="cite_ref-265" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-265"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>260<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-WaPoDesantis_266-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-WaPoDesantis-266"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>261<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-267" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-267"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>262<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> From June 2023 to January 2024, Musk hosted a bipartisan set of X Spaces with Republican and Democratic candidates, including <a href="/wiki/Robert_F._Kennedy_Jr." title="Robert F. Kennedy Jr.">Robert F. Kennedy Jr.</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-268" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-268"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>263<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <a href="/wiki/Vivek_Ramaswamy" title="Vivek Ramaswamy">Vivek Ramaswamy</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-269" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-269"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>264<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and <a href="/wiki/Dean_Phillips" title="Dean Phillips">Dean Phillips</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-270" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-270"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>265<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In 2024, he started supporting international <a href="/wiki/Far-right" class="mw-redirect" title="Far-right">far-right</a> political parties, activists, and causes,<sup id="cite_ref-Far-right=2025_271-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Far-right=2025-271"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>266<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and has shared far-right misinformation<sup id="cite_ref-272" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-272"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>267<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-273" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-273"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>268<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-274" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-274"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>269<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and numerous <a href="/wiki/Conspiracy_theories" class="mw-redirect" title="Conspiracy theories">conspiracy theories</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-275" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-275"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>270<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-276" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-276"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>271<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Since 2024, <a href="/wiki/Views_of_Elon_Musk" title="Views of Elon Musk">his views</a> have been generally described as right-wing.<sup id="cite_ref-277" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-277"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>272<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>

                    </div>
                </td>
            <td style="text-align: left; white-space: nowrap;"><b>Elon Musk</b> <div style="white-space: nowrap;"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only">(</span>@elonmusk<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only">)</span></div><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only"> tweeted:</span></td>
        </tr>
    </tbody></table>
    <blockquote style="text-align: left"><div style="margin:0.5em 0;padding:0">I fully endorse President Trump and hope for his rapid recovery</div></blockquote>
    <p style="margin:0;padding:0">July 13, 2024<sup id="cite_ref-278" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-278"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>273<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></p>
</div>
<p>By the middle of 2024, Musk had become a vocal and financial supporter of Donald Trump.<sup id="cite_ref-279" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-279"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>274<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In July 2024, minutes after Trump <a href="/wiki/Attempted_assassination_of_Donald_Trump_in_Pennsylvania" title="Attempted assassination of Donald Trump in Pennsylvania">survived an assassination attempt</a> while speaking in <a href="/wiki/Butler,_Pennsylvania" title="Butler, Pennsylvania">Butler, Pennsylvania</a>, Musk <a href="/wiki/List_of_Donald_Trump_2024_presidential_campaign_endorsements" title="List of Donald Trump 2024 presidential campaign endorsements">endorsed him for president</a> saying; "I fully endorse President Trump and hope for his rapid recovery."<sup id="cite_ref-280" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-280"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>275<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-fucked_281-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-fucked-281"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>276<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> During the <a href="/wiki/Donald_Trump_2024_presidential_campaign" title="Donald Trump 2024 presidential campaign">presidential campaign</a>, Musk joined Trump on stage at a campaign rally,<sup id="cite_ref-282" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-282"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>277<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and during the campaign promoted conspiracy theories and falsehoods about Democrats, <a href="/wiki/Election_denial_movement_in_the_United_States" title="Election denial movement in the United States">election fraud</a><sup id="cite_ref-Meyer_11012024_283-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Meyer_11012024-283"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>278<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and immigration, in support of Trump.<sup id="cite_ref-284" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-284"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>279<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-285" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-285"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>280<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk was the largest individual donor of the 2024 election.<sup id="cite_ref-Thadani_12062024_286-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Thadani_12062024-286"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>281<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Jacob Silverman, author of the 2025 book <i>Gilded Rage: Elon Musk and the Radicalization of Silicon Valley</i>, said that the tech industry represented by Musk, Thiel, <a href="/wiki/Marc_Andreessen" title="Marc Andreessen">Andreessen</a> and other capitalists, actually flourished under Biden, but the tech leaders chose Trump for their common ground on cultural issues.<sup id="cite_ref-287" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-287"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>282<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In 2023, Musk said he shunned the <a href="/wiki/World_Economic_Forum" title="World Economic Forum">World Economic Forum</a> (WEF) because it was boring. The organization commented that they had not invited him since 2015.<sup id="cite_ref-288" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-288"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>283<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk made a last-minute WEF debut in an interview with the organization's interim co-chair <a href="/wiki/Larry_Fink" title="Larry Fink">Larry Fink</a> during the <a href="/wiki/56th_World_Economic_Forum" title="56th World Economic Forum">2026 WEF</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-289" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-289"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>284<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-290" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-290"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>285<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> He also participated in <a href="/wiki/Dialog_(organization)" title="Dialog (organization)">Dialog</a>, dubbed "Tech <a href="/wiki/Bilderberg_Meeting" title="Bilderberg Meeting">Bilderberg</a>" and organized by <a href="/wiki/Peter_Thiel" title="Peter Thiel">Peter Thiel</a> and <a href="/wiki/Auren_Hoffman" title="Auren Hoffman">Auren Hoffman</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-291" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-291"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>286<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-292" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-292"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>287<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Starting in January 2025, Musk's international political actions and comments came under increasing scrutiny and criticism, especially from the governments and leaders of France, Germany, Norway, Spain and the United Kingdom, particularly due to his position in the <a href="/wiki/Second_Trump_administration" class="mw-redirect" title="Second Trump administration">U.S. government</a> from January to May 2025,<sup id="cite_ref-Musk-bids-farewell_293-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Musk-bids-farewell-293"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>288<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> as well as ownership of X.<sup id="cite_ref-Times_294-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Times-294"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>289<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-European_295-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-European-295"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>290<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-AfD_296-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-AfD-296"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>291<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> A February 2025 NBC News analysis found he had boosted far-right political movements to cut immigration and curtail regulation of business in at least 18 countries on six continents since 2023.<sup id="cite_ref-297" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-297"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>292<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In 2025, Musk contributed $19 million to the <a href="/wiki/2025_Wisconsin_Supreme_Court_election" title="2025 Wisconsin Supreme Court election">Wisconsin Supreme Court race</a>, hoping to influence the state's future <a href="/wiki/Redistricting" title="Redistricting">redistricting</a> efforts and its regulations governing car manufacturers and dealers.<sup id="cite_ref-298" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-298"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>293<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-299" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-299"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>294<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Salute_at_Trump's_second_inauguration"><span id="Salute_at_Trump.27s_second_inauguration"></span>Salute at Trump's second inauguration</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <a href="/wiki/Elon_Musk_salute_controversy" title="Elon Musk salute controversy">Elon Musk salute controversy</a></div>
<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/wiki/File:Elon_Musk%27s_Salute_at_Donald_Trump%27s_Second_Inauguration.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/9d/Elon_Musk%27s_Salute_at_Donald_Trump%27s_Second_Inauguration.gif/250px-Elon_Musk%27s_Salute_at_Donald_Trump%27s_Second_Inauguration.gif" decoding="async" width="250" height="141" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/9d/Elon_Musk%27s_Salute_at_Donald_Trump%27s_Second_Inauguration.gif/500px-Elon_Musk%27s_Salute_at_Donald_Trump%27s_Second_Inauguration.gif 2x" data-file-width="1920" data-file-height="1080"></a><figcaption>Musk giving a gesture at the <a href="/wiki/Second_inauguration_of_Donald_Trump" title="Second inauguration of Donald Trump">second inauguration of Donald Trump</a> before saying "My heart goes out to you. It is thanks to you that the future of civilization is assured."<sup id="cite_ref-cpdxzjw9p47o_300-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-cpdxzjw9p47o-300"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>295<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-nx-s1-5269719_301-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-nx-s1-5269719-301"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>296<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></figcaption></figure>
<p>During his speech after the <a href="/wiki/Second_inauguration_of_Donald_Trump" title="Second inauguration of Donald Trump">second inauguration of Donald Trump</a>, Musk twice made a gesture interpreted by many as a <a href="/wiki/Nazi_salute" title="Nazi salute">Nazi</a> or a fascist <a href="/wiki/Roman_salute" title="Roman salute">Roman salute</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-303" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-303"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>f<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> He thumped his right hand over his heart, fingers spread wide, and then extended his right arm out, emphatically, at an upward angle, palm down and fingers together. He then repeated the gesture to the crowd behind him. As he finished the gestures, he said to the crowd, "My heart goes out to you. It is thanks to you that the future of civilization is assured."<sup id="cite_ref-cpdxzjw9p47o_300-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-cpdxzjw9p47o-300"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>295<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-nx-s1-5269719_301-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-nx-s1-5269719-301"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>296<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-304" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-304"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>298<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>It was widely condemned as an intentional Nazi salute in Germany,<sup id="cite_ref-:62_305-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:62-305"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>299<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Bennhold-2025_306-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Bennhold-2025-306"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>300<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-307" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-307"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>301<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> where <a href="/wiki/Strafgesetzbuch_section_86a" title="Strafgesetzbuch section 86a">making such gestures is illegal</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-rbb24.de_308-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-rbb24.de-308"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>302<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The <a href="/wiki/Anti-Defamation_League" title="Anti-Defamation League">Anti-Defamation League</a> said it was not a Nazi salute,<sup id="cite_ref-:12_309-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:12-309"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>303<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> but other Jewish organizations disagreed and condemned the salute.<sup id="cite_ref-:72_310-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:72-310"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>304<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-:82_311-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:82-311"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>305<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-:9_312-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:9-312"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>306<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-:02_313-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:02-313"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>307<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> American public opinion was divided on partisan lines as to whether it was a fascist salute.<sup id="cite_ref-:10_314-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:10-314"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>308<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk dismissed the accusations of <a href="/wiki/Nazi" class="mw-redirect" title="Nazi">Nazi</a> sympathies, deriding them as "dirty tricks" and a "tired" attack.<sup id="cite_ref-315" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-315"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>309<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Fortinsky-2025a_316-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Fortinsky-2025a-316"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>310<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <a href="/wiki/Neo-Nazi" class="mw-redirect" title="Neo-Nazi">Neo-Nazi</a> and <a href="/wiki/White_supremacist" class="mw-redirect" title="White supremacist">white supremacist</a> groups celebrated it as a Nazi salute.<sup id="cite_ref-:12_309-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:12-309"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>303<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Condon-2025_317-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Condon-2025-317"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>311<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Multiple European political parties demanded that Musk be banned from entering their countries.<sup id="cite_ref-318" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-318"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>312<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-319" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-319"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>313<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Department_of_Government_Efficiency">Department of Government Efficiency</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <a href="/wiki/Department_of_Government_Efficiency" title="Department of Government Efficiency">Department of Government Efficiency</a></div>
<figure class="mw-halign-left" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/wiki/File:Elon_Musk_(54350004520).jpg" class="mw-file-description"><img src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/22/Elon_Musk_%2854350004520%29.jpg/250px-Elon_Musk_%2854350004520%29.jpg" decoding="async" width="250" height="375" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/22/Elon_Musk_%2854350004520%29.jpg/330px-Elon_Musk_%2854350004520%29.jpg 2x" data-file-width="2111" data-file-height="3164"></a><figcaption>Elon Musk wielding a chainsaw at the <a href="/wiki/Conservative_Political_Action_Conference" title="Conservative Political Action Conference">Conservative Political Action Conference</a> (CPAC) in 2025, imitating a publicity stunt used by <a href="/wiki/Javier_Milei" title="Javier Milei">Javier Milei</a> symbolic of efficiency, <a href="/wiki/2025_United_States_federal_mass_layoffs" title="2025 United States federal mass layoffs">federal mass layoffs</a> and <a href="/wiki/Tax_cut" title="Tax cut">tax cutting</a></figcaption></figure>
<p>The concept of DOGE emerged in a discussion between Musk and <a href="/wiki/Donald_Trump" title="Donald Trump">Donald Trump</a>, and in August 2024, Trump committed to giving Musk an advisory role, with Musk accepting the offer.<sup id="cite_ref-Shepardson_320-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Shepardson-320"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>314<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In November and December 2024, Musk suggested that the organization could help to cut the <a href="/wiki/United_States_federal_budget" title="United States federal budget">U.S. federal budget</a>, consolidate the number of federal agencies,<sup id="cite_ref-321" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-321"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>315<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-322" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-322"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>316<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and eliminate the <a href="/wiki/Consumer_Financial_Protection_Bureau" title="Consumer Financial Protection Bureau">Consumer Financial Protection Bureau</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-323" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-323"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>317<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-324" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-324"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>318<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and that its final stage would be "deleting itself".<sup id="cite_ref-325" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-325"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>319<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In January 2025, the organization was created by <a href="/wiki/Executive_order" title="Executive order">executive order</a>, and Musk was designated a "<a href="/wiki/Special_government_employee" title="Special government employee">special government employee</a>".<sup id="cite_ref-MD2_326-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-MD2-326"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>320<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Ngo_1212025_327-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Ngo_1212025-327"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>321<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk led the organization and was a <a href="/wiki/Senior_Advisor_to_the_President_of_the_United_States" title="Senior Advisor to the President of the United States">senior advisor to the president</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-328" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-328"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>322<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> although his <a href="/wiki/Political_activities_of_Elon_Musk" title="Political activities of Elon Musk">official role</a> is not clear.<sup id="cite_ref-Wolf2_329-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wolf2-329"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>323<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In sworn statement during a lawsuit, the director of the White House <a href="/wiki/Office_of_Administration" title="Office of Administration">Office of Administration</a> stated that Musk "is not an employee of the U.S. DOGE Service or U.S. DOGE Service Temporary Organization", "is not the U.S. DOGE Service administrator", and has "no actual or formal authority to make government decisions himself".<sup id="cite_ref-330" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-330"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>324<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-331" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-331"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>325<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Trump said two days later that he had put Musk in charge of DOGE.<sup id="cite_ref-332" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-332"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>326<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> A federal judge has ruled that Musk acted as the <i>de facto</i> leader of DOGE.<sup id="cite_ref-333" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-333"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>327<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Musk's role in the <a href="/wiki/Second_Trump_administration" class="mw-redirect" title="Second Trump administration">second Trump administration</a>, particularly in <a href="/wiki/Response_to_the_Department_of_Government_Efficiency" title="Response to the Department of Government Efficiency">response to DOGE</a>, has <a href="/wiki/Protests_against_Elon_Musk" title="Protests against Elon Musk">attracted public backlash</a>. He was criticized for his treatment of federal government employees,<sup id="cite_ref-nyt-young-aides-25_334-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-nyt-young-aides-25-334"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>328<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-nyt-swan-musk-feb-25_335-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-nyt-swan-musk-feb-25-335"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>329<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-wp-zs-25_336-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-wp-zs-25-336"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>330<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> including his influence over the <a href="/wiki/2025_United_States_federal_mass_layoffs" title="2025 United States federal mass layoffs">mass layoffs of the federal workforce</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-337" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-337"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>331<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-338" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-338"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>332<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-339" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-339"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>333<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> He has prioritized secrecy within the organization<sup id="cite_ref-The_New_York_Times_340-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-The_New_York_Times-340"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>334<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and has accused others of violating privacy laws.<sup id="cite_ref-MD2_326-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-MD2-326"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>320<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> A Senate report alleged that Musk could avoid up to $2 billion in legal liability as a result of DOGE's actions.<sup id="cite_ref-341" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-341"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>335<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In May 2025, <a href="/wiki/Bill_Gates" title="Bill Gates">Bill Gates</a> accused Musk of "killing the world's poorest children" through his cuts to <a href="/wiki/United_States_Agency_for_International_Development" title="United States Agency for International Development">USAID</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-342" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-342"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>336<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Modeling by <a href="/wiki/Boston_University" title="Boston University">Boston University</a> estimated the cuts resulted in 400,000 children and 200,000 adults deaths by November.<sup id="cite_ref-343" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-343"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>337<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-344" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-344"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>338<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-usaid-shutdown_345-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-usaid-shutdown-345"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>339<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk departed on May 28, 2025, when the special government employee's 130 day deadline expired.<sup id="cite_ref-346" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-346"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>340<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-347" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-347"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>341<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-348" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-348"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>342<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Feud_with_Donald_Trump">Feud with Donald Trump</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <a href="/wiki/Trump%E2%80%93Musk_feud" title="Trump–Musk feud">Trump–Musk feud</a></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1224211176"><div role="complementary" class="quotebox" style=";float:right;margin:.5em 0 .8em 1.4em;clear:right;width:220px">

                </td>

    <p style="margin:0;padding:0">June 5, 2025<sup id="cite_ref-349" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-349"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>343<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></p>
</div>
<p>After leaving office, Musk criticized the Trump administration's <a href="/wiki/One_Big_Beautiful_Bill_Act" title="One Big Beautiful Bill Act">Big Beautiful Bill</a>, calling it a "disgusting abomination" due to its provisions increasing the deficit.<sup id="cite_ref-350" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-350"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>344<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> A feud began between Musk and Trump, with its most notable event being Musk alleging Trump had ties to sex offender <a href="/wiki/Jeffrey_Epstein" title="Jeffrey Epstein">Jeffrey Epstein</a> on X (formerly Twitter) on June 5, 2025.<sup id="cite_ref-Epstein1_351-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Epstein1-351"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>345<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Epstein2_352-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Epstein2-352"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>346<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Trump responded on <a href="/wiki/Truth_Social" title="Truth Social">Truth Social</a> stating that Musk went "CRAZY" after the "EV Mandate" was purportedly taken away and threatened to cut Musk's government contracts.<sup id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEPager2025d_353-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEPager2025d-353"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>347<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEPager2025e_354-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEPager2025e-354"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>348<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk then called for a third Trump impeachment.<sup id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBasu2025_355-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBasu2025-355"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>349<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The next day, Trump stated that he did not wish to reconcile with Musk, and added that Musk would face "very serious consequences" if he funds Democratic candidates.<sup id="cite_ref-356" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-356"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>350<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> On June 11, Musk publicly apologized for the tweets against Trump before deleting them, saying they "went too far".<sup id="cite_ref-357" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-357"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>351<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Views">Views</h2></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <a href="/wiki/Views_of_Elon_Musk" title="Views of Elon Musk">Views of Elon Musk</a></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1224211176"><div role="complementary" class="quotebox" style=";float:left;margin:.5em 1.4em .8em 0;clear:left;width:220px">

            <td style="text-align: left; white-space: nowrap;"><b>Elon Musk</b> <div style="white-space: nowrap;"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only">(</span>@elonmusk<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only">)</span></div><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1152813436"><span class="sr-only"> tweeted:</span></td>

    <blockquote style="text-align: left"><div style="margin:0.5em 0;padding:0">My commitment to free speech extends even to not banning the account following my plane, even though that is a direct personal safety risk</div></blockquote>
    <p style="margin:0;padding:0">November 6, 2022<sup id="cite_ref-plane_358-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-plane-358"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>352<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
        </p>
</div>
<p>Rejecting the <a href="/wiki/Conservatism_in_the_United_States" title="Conservatism in the United States">conservative</a> label,<sup id="cite_ref-359" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-359"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>353<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk has described himself as a <a href="/wiki/Political_moderate" title="Political moderate">political moderate</a>, even as his views have become more <a href="/wiki/Right-wing" class="mw-redirect" title="Right-wing">right-wing</a> over time.<sup id="cite_ref-Right-wing_360-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Right-wing-360"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>354<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> His views have been characterized as <a href="/wiki/Libertarianism_in_the_United_States" title="Libertarianism in the United States">libertarian</a> and <a href="/wiki/Far-right" class="mw-redirect" title="Far-right">far-right</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-Libertarian_361-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Libertarian-361"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>355<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Far-right_362-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Far-right-362"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>356<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and after <a href="/wiki/Political_activities_of_Elon_Musk" title="Political activities of Elon Musk">his involvement in European politics</a>, they have received criticism from world leaders such as <a href="/wiki/Emmanuel_Macron" title="Emmanuel Macron">Emmanuel Macron</a> and <a href="/wiki/Olaf_Scholz" title="Olaf Scholz">Olaf Scholz</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-olaf_363-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-olaf-363"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>357<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Henley-2025_364-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Henley-2025-364"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>358<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-365" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-365"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>359<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-366" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-366"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>360<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Within the context of <a href="/wiki/Views_of_Elon_Musk#U.S._politics" title="Views of Elon Musk">American politics</a>, Musk supported Democratic candidates up until 2022, at which point he voted for a Republican for the first time.<sup id="cite_ref-:0_249-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:0-249"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>244<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-:1_367-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:1-367"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>361<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> He has stated support for <a href="/wiki/Universal_basic_income" title="Universal basic income">universal basic income</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-uni2_368-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-uni2-368"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>362<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <a href="/wiki/Gun_rights" class="mw-redirect" title="Gun rights">gun rights</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-369" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-369"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>363<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <a href="/wiki/Freedom_of_speech" title="Freedom of speech">freedom of speech</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-370" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-370"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>364<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> a <a href="/wiki/Tax_on_carbon_emissions" class="mw-redirect" title="Tax on carbon emissions">tax on carbon emissions</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-371" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-371"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>365<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and <a href="/wiki/H-1B_visa" title="H-1B visa">H-1B visas</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-CBS_News-2024_372-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-CBS_News-2024-372"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>366<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk has expressed concern about issues such as <a href="/wiki/Artificial_intelligence" title="Artificial intelligence">artificial intelligence</a> (AI)<sup id="cite_ref-wp2015_373-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-wp2015-373"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>367<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and <a href="/wiki/Climate_change" title="Climate change">climate change</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-374" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-374"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>368<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and has been a critic of <a href="/wiki/Wealth_tax" title="Wealth tax">wealth tax</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-375" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-375"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>369<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <a href="/wiki/Short-selling" class="mw-redirect" title="Short-selling">short-selling</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-376" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-376"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>370<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and <a href="/wiki/Government_subsidies" class="mw-redirect" title="Government subsidies">government subsidies</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-377" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-377"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>371<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> An immigrant himself, Musk has been accused of being <a href="/wiki/Anti-immigration" class="mw-redirect" title="Anti-immigration">anti-immigration</a>, and regularly blames <a href="/wiki/Immigration_policy_of_the_United_States" title="Immigration policy of the United States">immigration policies</a> for <a href="/wiki/Illegal_immigration_to_the_United_States" title="Illegal immigration to the United States">illegal immigration</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-Fearmongering_378-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Fearmongering-378"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>372<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> He is also a <a href="/wiki/Pronatalist" class="mw-redirect" title="Pronatalist">pronatalist</a> who believes <a href="/wiki/Population_decline" title="Population decline">population decline</a> is the biggest threat to civilization,<sup id="cite_ref-Pronatlist_379-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Pronatlist-379"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>373<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and identifies as a <a href="/wiki/Cultural_Christian" class="mw-redirect" title="Cultural Christian">cultural Christian</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-O'Mahony2024_380-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-O'Mahony2024-380"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>374<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-381" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-381"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>375<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk has long been an advocate for <a href="/wiki/Space_colonization" title="Space colonization">space colonization</a>, especially the <a href="/wiki/Colonization_of_Mars" title="Colonization of Mars">colonization of Mars</a>. He has repeatedly pushed for humanity colonizing Mars, in order to become an interplanetary species and lower the risks of <a href="/wiki/Human_extinction" title="Human extinction">human extinction</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-SpaceX_382-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-SpaceX-382"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>376<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Musk has <a href="/wiki/Views_of_Elon_Musk#Conspiracy_theories" title="Views of Elon Musk">promoted conspiracy theories</a> and <a href="/wiki/Views_of_Elon_Musk#Race_and_white_nationalism" title="Views of Elon Musk">made controversial statements</a> that have led to accusations of <a href="/wiki/Racism" title="Racism">racism</a>, <a href="/wiki/Sexism" title="Sexism">sexism</a>, <a href="/wiki/Antisemitism" title="Antisemitism">antisemitism</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-383" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-383"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>377<span href="/wiki/White_pride" title="White pride">white pride</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-Proud_386-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Proud-386"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>380<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Derbyshire-2025_387-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Derbyshire-2025-387"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>381<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> While describing himself as a "pro-Semite",<sup id="cite_ref-CNBC160523_388-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-CNBC160523-388"><span League">Anti-Defamation League</a> and the Biden <a href="/wiki/White_House" title="White House">White House</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-Condemned_389-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Condemned-389"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>383<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk was criticized during the COVID-19 pandemic for making unfounded
