class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="International_relations">International relations</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <a href="/wiki/International_relations_of_Elon_Musk" title="International relations of Elon Musk">International relations of Elon Musk</a></div>
<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/wiki/File:Isaac_Herzog_in_Beit_HaNassi,_November_2023_(GPOHZ02222_2).jpeg" class="mw-file-description"><img src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/12/Isaac_Herzog_in_Beit_HaNassi%2C_November_2023_%28GPOHZ02222_2%29.jpeg/250px-Isaac_Herzog_in_Beit_HaNassi%2C_November_2023_%28GPOHZ02222_2%29.jpeg" decoding="async" width="250" height="165" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/12/Isaac_Herzog_in_Beit_HaNassi%2C_November_2023_%28GPOHZ02222_2%29.jpeg/500px-Isaac_Herzog_in_Beit_HaNassi%2C_November_2023_%28GPOHZ02222_2%29.jpeg 2x" data-file-width="1503" data-file-height="994"></a><figcaption>Musk with Israeli president <a href="/wiki/Isaac_Herzog" title="Isaac Herzog">Isaac Herzog</a>, November 2023</figcaption></figure>
<p>Musk has been critical of Israel's <a href="/wiki/Israeli_invasion_of_the_Gaza_Strip" class="mw-redirect" title="Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip">actions</a> in the <a href="/wiki/Gaza_Strip" title="Gaza Strip">Gaza Strip</a> during the <a href="/wiki/Gaza_war" title="Gaza war">Gaza war</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-Robertson-20232_395-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Robertson-20232-395"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>389<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> praised China's economic and climate goals,<sup id="cite_ref-He-20212_396-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-He-20212-396"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>390<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Choi-20192_397-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Choi-20192-397"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>391<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> suggested that <a href="/wiki/Taiwan" title="Taiwan">Taiwan</a> and China should resolve <a href="/wiki/Cross-strait_relations" title="Cross-strait relations">cross-strait relations</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-Liang-20222_398-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Liang-20222-398"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>392<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Khalaf-20222_399-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Khalaf-20222-399"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>393<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and was described as having a close relationship with the <a href="/wiki/Chinese_government" class="mw-redirect" title="Chinese government">Chinese government</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-He-20212_396-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-He-20212-396"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>390<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Choi-20192_397-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Choi-20192-397"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>391<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In Europe, Musk expressed support for Ukraine in 2022 during the <a href="/wiki/Russian_invasion_of_Ukraine" class="mw-redirect" title="Russian invasion of Ukraine">Russian invasion</a>, recommended referendums and peace deals on the annexed <a href="/wiki/Russian-occupied_territories_of_Ukraine" title="Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine">Russia-occupied territories</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-Oshin-20222_400-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Oshin-20222-400"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>394<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Wilson-20222_401-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wilson-20222-401"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>395<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and supported the far-right <a href="/wiki/Alternative_for_Germany" title="Alternative for Germany">Alternative for Germany</a> political party in 2024.<sup id="cite_ref-Gold-20242_402-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Gold-20242-402"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>396<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Regarding <a href="/wiki/British_politics" class="mw-redirect" title="British politics">British politics</a>, Musk blamed the <a href="/wiki/2024_United_Kingdom_riots" title="2024 United Kingdom riots">2024 UK riots</a> on <a href="/wiki/Modern_immigration_to_the_United_Kingdom" title="Modern immigration to the United Kingdom">mass migration</a> and <a href="/wiki/Open_border" title="Open border">open borders</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-Gregory-20242_403-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Gregory-20242-403"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>397<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-BBC_News-2024a2_404-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-BBC_News-2024a2-404"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>398<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> criticized Prime Minister <a href="/wiki/Keir_Starmer" title="Keir Starmer">Keir Starmer</a> for what he described as a "two-tier" policing system,<sup id="cite_ref-The_Independent-20242_405-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-The_Independent-20242-405"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>399<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-The_Daily_Telegraph-20242_406-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-The_Daily_Telegraph-20242-406"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>400<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-BBC_News-2024a2_404-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-BBC_News-2024a2-404"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>398<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and was subsequently attacked as being responsible for spreading <a href="/wiki/Misinformation" title="Misinformation">misinformation</a> and amplifying the far-right.<sup id="cite_ref-BBC_News2_407-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-BBC_News2-407"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>401<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk has publicly supported far-right activist <a href="/wiki/Tommy_Robinson" title="Tommy Robinson">Tommy Robinson</a>, and initially pledged financial backing to <a href="/wiki/Reform_UK" title="Reform UK">Reform UK</a> ahead of the next general election. In January 2025, he publicly fell out with Reform UK leader <a href="/wiki/Nigel_Farage" title="Nigel Farage">Nigel Farage</a>, calling for Farage to be replaced as party leader.<sup id="cite_ref-BBC_News-20252_408-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-BBC_News-20252-408"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>402<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Turvill-20242_409-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Turvill-20242-409"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>403<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk subsequently shifted his backing towards <a href="/wiki/Restore_Britain" title="Restore Britain">Restore Britain</a>, the political party launched by <a href="/wiki/Rupert_Lowe" title="Rupert Lowe">Rupert Lowe</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-410" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-410"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>404<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In February 2026, Musk described Spanish Prime Minister <a href="/wiki/Pedro_S%C3%A1nchez" title="Pedro Sánchez">Pedro Sánchez</a> as a "tyrant" following Sánchez's proposal to <a href="/wiki/Social_media_age_verification_laws_by_country#Spain" title="Social media age verification laws by country">prohibit minors</a> under the age of 16 from accessing social media platforms.<sup id="cite_ref-411" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-411"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>405<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Legal_affairs">Legal affairs</h2></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <a href="/wiki/Legal_affairs_of_Elon_Musk" title="Legal affairs of Elon Musk">Legal affairs of Elon Musk</a></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Further information: <a href="/wiki/List_of_lawsuits_involving_Tesla,_Inc." title="List of lawsuits involving Tesla, Inc.">List of lawsuits involving Tesla, Inc.</a> and <a href="/wiki/Criticism_of_Tesla,_Inc." title="Criticism of Tesla, Inc.">Criticism of Tesla, Inc.</a></div>
<p>In 2018, Musk was <a href="/wiki/Tesla,_Inc.#Lawsuits_and_controversies" title="Tesla, Inc.">sued</a> by the <a href="/wiki/U.S._Securities_and_Exchange_Commission" class="mw-redirect" title="U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission">U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission</a> (SEC) for a <a href="/wiki/Tweet_(social_media)" title="Tweet (social media)">tweet</a> stating that funding had been secured for potentially taking Tesla private.<sup id="cite_ref-Goldstein_27-9-18_146-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Goldstein_27-9-18-146"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>142<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-415" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-415"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>g<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The securities fraud lawsuit characterized the tweet as false, misleading, and damaging to investors, and sought to bar Musk from serving as CEO of <a href="/wiki/Public_company" title="Public company">publicly traded companies</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-Goldstein_27-9-18_146-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Goldstein_27-9-18-146"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>142<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-416" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-416"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>409<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-OkaneLopatto18_417-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-OkaneLopatto18-417"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>410<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Two days later, Musk settled with the SEC, without admitting or denying the SEC's allegations. As a result, Musk and Tesla were fined $20 million each, and Musk was forced to step down for three years as Tesla chairman but was able to remain as CEO.<sup id="cite_ref-:7_147-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:7-147"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>143<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Shareholders filed a lawsuit over the tweet,<sup id="cite_ref-418" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-418"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>411<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and in February 2023, a jury found Musk and Tesla not liable.<sup id="cite_ref-419" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-419"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>412<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk has stated in interviews that he does not regret posting the tweet that triggered the SEC investigation.<sup id="cite_ref-420" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-420"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>413<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-421" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-421"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>414<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In 2019, Musk stated in a tweet that Tesla would build half a million cars that year.<sup id="cite_ref-422" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-422"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>415<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The SEC reacted by asking a court to hold him <a href="/wiki/Contempt_of_court" title="Contempt of court">in contempt</a> for violating the terms of the 2018 settlement agreement. A joint agreement between Musk and the SEC eventually clarified the previous agreement details,<sup id="cite_ref-423" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-423"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>416<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> including a list of topics about which Musk needed preclearance.<sup id="cite_ref-424" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-424"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>417<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2020, a judge blocked a lawsuit that claimed a tweet by Musk regarding Tesla stock price ("too high <a href="/wiki/List_of_acronyms:_I" title="List of acronyms: I">imo</a>") violated the agreement.<sup id="cite_ref-425" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-425"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>418<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-426" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-426"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>419<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <a href="/wiki/Freedom_of_Information_Act_(United_States)" title="Freedom of Information Act (United States)">Freedom of Information Act</a> (FOIA)-released records showed that the SEC concluded Musk had subsequently violated the agreement twice by tweeting regarding "<a href="/wiki/Tesla_Energy" title="Tesla Energy">Tesla's solar roof</a> production volumes and its stock price".<sup id="cite_ref-427" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-427"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>420<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In October 2023, the SEC sued Musk over his refusal to testify a third time in an investigation into whether he violated federal law by purchasing Twitter stock in 2022.<sup id="cite_ref-Brodkin-2023_428-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Brodkin-2023-428"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>421<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-429" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-429"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>422<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Regulator_sues_Musk_to_force_testimony_in_X_probe-2023_430-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Regulator_sues_Musk_to_force_testimony_in_X_probe-2023-430"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>423<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In February 2024, Judge Laurel Beeler ruled that Musk must testify again.<sup id="cite_ref-431" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-431"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>424<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In January 2025, the SEC filed a lawsuit against Musk for securities violations related to his purchase of Twitter.<sup id="cite_ref-432" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-432"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>425<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In January 2024, Delaware judge <a href="/wiki/Kathaleen_McCormick" title="Kathaleen McCormick">Kathaleen McCormick</a> ruled in a 2018 lawsuit that Musk's $55 billion pay package from Tesla be rescinded.<sup id="cite_ref-433" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-433"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>426<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> McCormick called the compensation granted by the company's board "an unfathomable sum" that was unfair to shareholders.<sup id="cite_ref-434" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-434"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>427<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The <a href="/wiki/Delaware_Supreme_Court" title="Delaware Supreme Court">Delaware Supreme Court</a> overturned McCormick's decision in December 2025, restoring Musk's compensation package and awarding $1 in <a href="/wiki/Nominal_damages" class="mw-redirect" title="Nominal damages">nominal damages</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-435" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-435"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>428<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>On March 20, 2026, a jury in <a href="/wiki/San_Francisco,_California" class="mw-redirect" title="San Francisco, California">San Francisco, California</a>, found Musk liable for misleading investors during his <a href="/wiki/Acquisition_of_Twitter_by_Elon_Musk" title="Acquisition of Twitter by Elon Musk">acquisition of Twitter</a>, though they absolved him of some fraud allegations, finding he did not "scheme" to defraud investors.<sup id="cite_ref-misleadverdict_436-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-misleadverdict-436"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>429<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-lat-jury-finds-elon-musk-misled-investors-during-twitter-purchase_437-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-lat-jury-finds-elon-musk-misled-investors-during-twitter-purchase-437"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>430<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Specifically, Musk was found to have misled shareholders in two tweets, but not in a podcast, as the views he expressed in that were deemed by the jury to be an opinion.<sup id="cite_ref-misleadverdict_436-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-misleadverdict-436"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>429<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-lat-jury-finds-elon-musk-misled-investors-during-twitter-purchase_437-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-lat-jury-finds-elon-musk-misled-investors-during-twitter-purchase-437"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>430<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Damages have yet to be calculated, but plaintiffs' lawyers estimated them to be $2.5 billion.<sup id="cite_ref-438" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-438"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>431<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p><a href="/wiki/Jury_selection" title="Jury selection">Jury selection</a> for Musk's <a href="/wiki/Musk_v._Altman" title="Musk v. Altman">lawsuit</a> against OpenAI and its current executives, including <a href="/wiki/Sam_Altman" title="Sam Altman">Sam Altman</a> and <a href="/wiki/Greg_Brockman" title="Greg Brockman">Greg Brockman</a>, began on April 27, 2026.<sup id="cite_ref-439" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-439"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>432<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-440" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-440"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>433<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> On April 28, 2026, trial testimony was by now underway, with Elon Musk beginning his testimony against Altman and OpenAI.<sup id="cite_ref-441" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-441"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>434<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> On April 30, 2026 Musk would enter his third day of testimony.<sup id="cite_ref-442" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-442"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>435<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Personal_life">Personal life</h2></div>
<figure typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/wiki/File:Elon_Musk_Royal_Society.jpg" class="mw-file-description"><img src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ed/Elon_Musk_Royal_Society.jpg/250px-Elon_Musk_Royal_Society.jpg" decoding="async" width="250" height="375" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ed/Elon_Musk_Royal_Society.jpg/500px-Elon_Musk_Royal_Society.jpg 2x" data-file-width="1666" data-file-height="2500"></a><figcaption>Official <a href="/wiki/Royal_Society" title="Royal Society">Royal Society</a> portrait, 2018</figcaption></figure>
<p>Musk became a U.S. citizen in 2002.<sup id="cite_ref-:6_53-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:6-53"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>51<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> From the early 2000s until late 2020, Musk resided in California, where both Tesla and SpaceX were founded.<sup id="cite_ref-bloomberg20201208_443-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-bloomberg20201208-443"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>436<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> He then relocated to <a href="/wiki/Cameron_County,_Texas" title="Cameron County, Texas">Cameron County, Texas</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-444" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-444"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>437<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-445" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-445"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>438<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> saying that California had become "complacent" about its economic success.<sup id="cite_ref-bloomberg20201208_443-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-bloomberg20201208-443"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>436<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-446" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-446"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>439<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-447" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-447"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>440<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>While hosting <i><a href="/wiki/Saturday_Night_Live" title="Saturday Night Live">Saturday Night Live</a></i> in 2021, Musk stated that he has <a href="/wiki/Asperger_syndrome" title="Asperger syndrome">Asperger syndrome</a> (a superseded term for a mild strain of <a href="/wiki/Autism" title="Autism">autism spectrum disorder</a>).<sup id="cite_ref-448" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-448"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>441<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> He was not diagnosed as a child.<sup id="cite_ref-449" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-449"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>442<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> When asked about his experience growing up with Asperger's syndrome the following year, Musk stated that "the social cues were not intuitive<span class="nowrap"> </span>... I would just tend to take things very literally<span class="nowrap"> </span>... but then that turned out to be wrong — [people were not] simply saying exactly what they mean, there's all sorts of other things that are meant, and [it] took me a while to figure that out."<sup id="cite_ref-450" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-450"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>443<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk suffers from back pain and has undergone several spine-related surgeries, including a <a href="/wiki/Intervertebral_disc" title="Intervertebral disc">disc</a> replacement.<sup id="cite_ref-451" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-451"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>444<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-452" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-452"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>445<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2000, he contracted a severe case of <a href="/wiki/Malaria" title="Malaria">malaria</a> while on vacation in South Africa.<sup id="cite_ref-453" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-453"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>446<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Musk has stated he uses doctor-prescribed <a href="/wiki/Ketamine" title="Ketamine">ketamine</a> for occasional depression and that he doses "a small amount once every other week or something like that";<sup id="cite_ref-454" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-454"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>447<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> since January 2024, some media outlets have reported that he takes ketamine, <a href="/wiki/Marijuana" class="mw-redirect" title="Marijuana">marijuana</a>, <a href="/wiki/LSD" title="LSD">LSD</a>, <a href="/wiki/Ecstasy_(drug)" class="mw-redirect" title="Ecstasy (drug)">ecstasy</a>, <a href="/wiki/Hallucinogenic_mushrooms" class="mw-redirect" title="Hallucinogenic mushrooms">mushrooms</a>, <a href="/wiki/Cocaine" title="Cocaine">cocaine</a> and other drugs. Musk at first refused to comment on his alleged drug use, before responding that he had not <a href="/wiki/Drug_test" title="Drug test">tested</a> positive for drugs, and that if drugs somehow improved his productivity, "I would definitely take them!".<sup id="cite_ref-455" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-455"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>448<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <i><a href="/wiki/The_New_York_Times" title="The New York Times">The New York Times'</a></i> investigations revealed Musk's overuse of ketamine and numerous other drugs, as well as strained family relationships and concerns from close associates who have become troubled by his public behavior as he became more involved in political activities and government work.<sup id="cite_ref-456" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-456"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>449<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> According to <i>The Washington Post</i>, President Trump described Musk as "a big-time drug addict".<sup id="cite_ref-457" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-457"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>450<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Through his own label Emo G Records, Musk released a <a href="/wiki/Rap" class="mw-redirect" title="Rap">rap</a> track, "RIP <a href="/wiki/Harambe" title="Harambe">Harambe</a>", on <a href="/wiki/SoundCloud" title="SoundCloud">SoundCloud</a> in March 2019.<sup id="cite_ref-458" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-458"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>451<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-459" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-459"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>452<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Fitzgerald_460-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Fitzgerald-460"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>453<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The following year, he released an <a href="/wiki/Electronic_dance_music" title="Electronic dance music">EDM</a> track, "Don't Doubt Ur Vibe", featuring his own lyrics and vocals.<sup id="cite_ref-Etherington_461-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Etherington-461"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>454<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Musk plays video games, which he stated has a "'restoring effect' that helps his 'mental calibration'".<sup id="cite_ref-462" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-462"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>455<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Some games he plays include <a href="/wiki/Quake_(series)" title="Quake (series)"><i>Quake</i></a>, <i><a href="/wiki/Diablo_IV" title="Diablo IV">Diablo IV</a></i>, <i><a href="/wiki/Elden_Ring" title="Elden Ring">Elden Ring</a></i>, and <a href="/wiki/The_Battle_of_Polytopia" title="The Battle of Polytopia"><i>Polytopia</i></a>.<sup id="cite_ref-463" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-463"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>456<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-464" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-464"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>457<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk once claimed to be one of the world's top video game players but has since admitted to "<a href="/wiki/Boosting_(video_games)" title="Boosting (video games)">account boosting</a>", or cheating by hiring outside services to achieve top player rankings.<sup id="cite_ref-465" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-465"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>458<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-466" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-466"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>459<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Gizmodo_Paying_467-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Gizmodo_Paying-467"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>460<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk has justified the boosting by claiming that all top accounts do it so he has to as well to remain competitive.<sup id="cite_ref-468" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-468"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>461<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Gizmodo_Paying_467-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Gizmodo_Paying-467"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>460<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-469" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-469"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>462<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2024 and 2025, Musk criticized the video game <i><a href="/wiki/Assassin%27s_Creed_Shadows" title="Assassin's Creed Shadows">Assassin's Creed Shadows</a></i> and its creator <a href="/wiki/Ubisoft" title="Ubisoft">Ubisoft</a> for "woke" content.<sup id="cite_ref-PC_Gamer_Ratio_470-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-PC_Gamer_Ratio-470"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>463<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk posted to X that "DEI kills art" and specified the inclusion of the historical figure <a href="/wiki/Yasuke" title="Yasuke">Yasuke</a> in the <i>Assassin's Creed</i> game as offensive; he also called the game "terrible". Ubisoft responded by saying that Musk's comments were "just feeding hatred" and that they were focused on producing a game not pushing politics.<sup id="cite_ref-471" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-471"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>464<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-472" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-472"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>465<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Relationships_and_children">Relationships and children</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Further information: <a href="/wiki/Musk_family" title="Musk family">Musk family</a></div>
<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/wiki/File:X_%C3%86_A-Xii,_Elon_Musk_and_Donald_Trump_in_the_Oval_Office_-_P20250207DT-0103_(54320797642).jpg" class="mw-file-description"><img src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/14/X_%C3%86_A-Xii%2C_Elon_Musk_and_Donald_Trump_in_the_Oval_Office_-_P20250207DT-0103_%2854320797642%29.jpg/250px-X_%C3%86_A-Xii%2C_Elon_Musk_and_Donald_Trump_in_the_Oval_Office_-_P20250207DT-0103_%2854320797642%29.jpg" decoding="async" width="250" height="167" style="--mw-file-upright: 1" class="mw-file-element mw-file-upright" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/14/X_%C3%86_A-Xii%2C_Elon_Musk_and_Donald_Trump_in_the_Oval_Office_-_P20250207DT-0103_%2854320797642%29.jpg/500px-X_%C3%86_A-Xii%2C_Elon_Musk_and_Donald_Trump_in_the_Oval_Office_-_P20250207DT-0103_%2854320797642%29.jpg 2x" data-file-width="3000" data-file-height="2000"></a><figcaption>Musk with his son, X Æ A-Xii, in the <a href="/wiki/Oval_Office" title="Oval Office">Oval Office</a> on February 11, 2025</figcaption></figure>
<p>Musk has fathered at least 14 children, one of whom died as an infant.<sup id="cite_ref-473" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-473"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>466<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <i>The Wall Street Journal</i> reported in 2025 that sources close to Musk suggest that the "true number of Musk's children is much higher than publicly known".<sup id="cite_ref-Mattioli_16APR2025_2-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Mattioli_16APR2025-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> He had six children with his first wife, Canadian author <a href="/wiki/Justine_Wilson" class="mw-redirect" title="Justine Wilson">Justine Wilson</a>, whom he met while attending Queen's University in Ontario, Canada; they married in 2000.<sup id="cite_ref-Streisand-2015_474-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Streisand-2015-474"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>467<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2002, their first child, Nevada Alexander Musk, died of <a href="/wiki/Sudden_infant_death_syndrome" class="mw-redirect" title="Sudden infant death syndrome">sudden infant death syndrome</a> at the age of 10 days.<sup id="cite_ref-sids_475-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-sids-475"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>468<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> After his death, the couple used <a href="/wiki/In_vitro_fertilisation" title="In vitro fertilisation">in vitro fertilization</a> (IVF) to continue their family;<sup id="cite_ref-holywoodlife2021_476-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-holywoodlife2021-476"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>469<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> they had twins in 2004, followed by triplets in 2006.<sup id="cite_ref-holywoodlife2021_476-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-holywoodlife2021-476"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>469<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The couple divorced in 2008 and have <a href="/wiki/Joint_custody_(United_States)" class="mw-redirect" title="Joint custody (United States)">shared custody</a> of their children.<sup id="cite_ref-477" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-477"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>470<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-478" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-478"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>471<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The elder twin he had with Wilson <a href="/wiki/Gender_identity" title="Gender identity">came out</a> as a <a href="/wiki/Trans_woman" title="Trans woman">trans woman</a> and, in 2022, officially <a href="/wiki/Name_change" title="Name change">changed her name</a> to <a href="/wiki/Vivian_Wilson" title="Vivian Wilson">Vivian Jenna Wilson</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-06-23-22_479-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-06-23-22-479"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>472<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> adopting her mother's surname because she no longer wished to be associated with Musk.<sup id="cite_ref-06-23-22_479-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-06-23-22-479"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>472<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Musk began dating English actress <a href="/wiki/Talulah_Riley" title="Talulah Riley">Talulah Riley</a> in 2008.<sup id="cite_ref-480" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-480"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>473<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> They married two years later at <a href="/wiki/Dornoch_Cathedral" title="Dornoch Cathedral">Dornoch Cathedral</a> in Scotland.<sup id="cite_ref-marriage_481-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-marriage-481"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>474<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-482" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-482"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>475<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2012, the couple divorced, then remarried the following year.<sup id="cite_ref-talulah_483-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-talulah-483"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>476<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> After briefly filing for divorce in 2014,<sup id="cite_ref-talulah_483-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-talulah-483"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>476<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk finalized a second divorce from Riley in 2016.<sup id="cite_ref-484" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-484"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>477<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk then dated the American actress <a href="/wiki/Amber_Heard" title="Amber Heard">Amber Heard</a> for several months in 2017;<sup id="cite_ref-485" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-485"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>478<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> he had reportedly been "pursuing" her since 2012.<sup id="cite_ref-hollywood_486-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-hollywood-486"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>479<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In 2018, Musk and Canadian musician <a href="/wiki/Grimes" title="Grimes">Grimes</a> confirmed they were dating.<sup id="cite_ref-487" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-487"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>480<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Grimes and Musk have three children, born in 2020, 2021, and 2022.<sup id="cite_ref-492" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-492"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>h<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk and Grimes originally gave their eldest child the name "X <a href="/wiki/%C3%86" title="Æ">Æ</a> A-12", which would have violated California regulations as it contained characters that are not in the modern English alphabet;<sup id="cite_ref-493" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-493"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>485<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-494" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-494"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>486<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> the names registered on the birth certificate are "X" as a first name, "Æ A-<a href="/wiki/Roman_numerals" title="Roman numerals">Xii</a>" as a middle name, and "Musk" as a last name.<sup id="cite_ref-495" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-495"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>487<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-xaea-xii.cnet_496-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-xaea-xii.cnet-496"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>488<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> They received criticism for choosing a name perceived to be impractical and difficult to pronounce;<sup id="cite_ref-497" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-497"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>489<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk has said the intended pronunciation is "X Ash A Twelve".<sup id="cite_ref-xaea-xii.cnet_496-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-xaea-xii.cnet-496"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>488<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Their second child was born via <a href="/wiki/Surrogacy" title="Surrogacy">surrogacy</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-GrimesVanityFair2022_498-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-GrimesVanityFair2022-498"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>490<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Despite the pregnancy, Musk confirmed reports that the couple were "semi-separated" in September 2021; in an interview with <a href="/wiki/Time_(magazine)" title="Time (magazine)"><i>Time</i></a> in December 2021, he said he was single.<sup id="cite_ref-499" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-499"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>491<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-500" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-500"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>492<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In October 2023, Grimes sued Musk over parental rights and custody of X Æ A-Xii.<sup id="cite_ref-501" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-501"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>493<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-502" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-502"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>494<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-503" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-503"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>495<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Elon Musk has taken X Æ A-Xii to multiple official events in Washington, D.C. during <a href="/wiki/Second_presidency_of_Donald_Trump" title="Second presidency of Donald Trump">Trump's second term in office</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-504" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-504"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>496<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Also in July 2022, <i>The Wall Street Journal</i> reported that Musk allegedly had an affair with <a href="/wiki/Nicole_Shanahan" title="Nicole Shanahan">Nicole Shanahan</a>, the wife of Google co-founder <a href="/wiki/Sergey_Brin" title="Sergey Brin">Sergey Brin</a>, in 2021, leading to their divorce the following year.<sup id="cite_ref-505" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-505"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>497<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk denied the report.<sup id="cite_ref-506" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-506"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>498<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk also had a relationship with Australian actress <a href="/wiki/Natasha_Bassett" title="Natasha Bassett">Natasha Bassett</a>, who has been described as "an occasional girlfriend".<sup id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEIsaacson20237,_265_507-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEIsaacson20237,_265-507"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>499<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In October 2024, <i>The New York Times</i> reported Musk bought a Texas compound for his children and their mothers,<sup id="cite_ref-508" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-508"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>500<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> though Musk denied having done so.<sup id="cite_ref-509" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-509"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>501<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Musk also has four children with <a href="/wiki/Shivon_Zilis" title="Shivon Zilis">Shivon Zilis</a>, director of operations and special projects at <a href="/wiki/Neuralink" title="Neuralink">Neuralink</a>: twins born via <a href="/wiki/In_vitro_fertilisation" title="In vitro fertilisation">IVF</a> in 2021, a child born in 2024 via surrogacy and a child born in 2025.<sup id="cite_ref-516" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-516"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>i<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>On February 14, 2025, <a href="/wiki/Ashley_St._Clair" title="Ashley St. Clair">Ashley St. Clair</a>, an influencer and author, posted on X claiming to have given birth to Musk's son Romulus five months earlier, which media outlets reported as Musk's supposed thirteenth child.<sup id="cite_ref-520" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-520"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>j<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> On February 22, 2025, it was reported that St Clair had filed for sole custody of her five-month-old son and for Musk to be recognised as the child's father.<sup id="cite_ref-521" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-521"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>511<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-522" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-522"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>512<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> On March 31, 2025, Musk wrote that, while he was unsure if he was the father of St. Clair's child, he had paid St. Clair $2.5<span class="nowrap"> </span>million and would continue paying her $500,000 per year.<sup id="cite_ref-528" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-528"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>k<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Later reporting from the <i>Wall Street Journal</i> indicated that $1<span class="nowrap"> </span>million of these payments to St. Clair were structured as a loan.<sup id="cite_ref-Mattioli_16APR2025_2-3" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Mattioli_16APR2025-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Involvement_with_Jeffrey_Epstein">Involvement with Jeffrey Epstein</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">See also: <a href="/wiki/List_of_people_named_in_the_Epstein_files" title="List of people named in the Epstein files">List of people named in the Epstein files</a></div>
<p>In 2014, Musk and <a href="/wiki/Ghislaine_Maxwell" title="Ghislaine Maxwell">Ghislaine Maxwell</a> appeared together in a photograph taken at an Academy Awards after-party, which Musk later described as a "<a href="/wiki/Photobombing" title="Photobombing">photobomb</a>".<sup id="cite_ref-529" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-529"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>518<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-:13_23-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:13-23"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>21<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The January 2026 <a href="/wiki/Epstein_files" title="Epstein files">Epstein files</a> contain emails between Musk and Epstein from 2012 to 2013, after <a href="/wiki/Jeffrey_Epstein#First_criminal_case_(2005–2011)" title="Jeffrey Epstein">Epstein's first conviction</a>.
</p><p>Emails released on January 30, 2026, indicated that Epstein invited Musk to visit his private island on multiple occasions.<sup id="cite_ref-530" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-530"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>519<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The correspondence showed that while Epstein repeatedly encouraged Musk to attend, Musk did not visit the island. In one instance, Musk discussed the possibility of attending a party with his then-wife <a href="/wiki/Talulah_Riley" title="Talulah Riley">Talulah Riley</a> and asked which day would be the "wildest party"; according to the emails, the visit did not take place after Epstein later cancelled the plans.<sup id="cite_ref-536" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-536"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>l<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>On <a href="/wiki/Christmas_day" class="mw-redirect" title="Christmas day">Christmas day</a> in 2012, Musk emailed Epstein asking "Do you have any parties planned? I've been working to the edge of sanity this year and so, once my kids head home after Christmas, I really want to hit the party scene in <a href="/wiki/St._Barts" class="mw-redirect" title="St. Barts">St Barts</a> or elsewhere and let loose. The invitation is much appreciated, but a peaceful island experience is the opposite of what I'm looking for".<sup id="cite_ref-RobinsEarly2026_537-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-RobinsEarly2026-537"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>525<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Epstein replied that the "ratio on my island" might make Musk's wife uncomfortable to which Musk responded, "Ratio is not a problem for Talulah".<sup id="cite_ref-RobinsEarly2026_537-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-RobinsEarly2026-537"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>525<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>On September 11, 2013, Epstein sent an email asking Musk if he had any plans for coming to New York for the opening of the <a href="/wiki/United_Nations_General_Assembly" title="United Nations General Assembly">United Nations General Assembly</a>, saying that many "interesting people" would be coming to Epstein's house. Musk responded that "Flying to NY to see UN diplomats do nothing would be an unwise use of time".<sup id="cite_ref-Rascius2026_538-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Rascius2026-538"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>526<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Epstein responded by stating "Do you think i am retarded. Just kidding, there is no one over 25 and all very cute."<sup id="cite_ref-Rascius2026_538-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Rascius2026-538"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>526<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Musk has denied any close relationship with Epstein and described him as a "creep" who attempted to ingratiate himself with influential people.<sup id="cite_ref-:13_23-3" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:13-23"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>21<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> When Musk was asked in 2019 if he introduced Epstein to <a href="/wiki/Mark_Zuckerberg" title="Mark Zuckerberg">Mark Zuckerberg</a>, Musk responded: "I don't recall introducing Epstein to anyone, as I don't know the guy well enough to do so."<sup id="cite_ref-Rascius2026_538-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Rascius2026-538"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>526<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The released emails nonetheless showed cordial exchanges on a range of topics, including Musk's inquiry about parties on the island.<sup id="cite_ref-theguardian.com_534-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-theguardian.com-534"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>523<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-539" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-539"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>527<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-:13_23-4" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-:13-23"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>21<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The correspondence also indicated that Musk suggested hosting Epstein at SpaceX, while Epstein separately discussed plans to tour SpaceX and bring "the girls", though there is no evidence that such a visit occurred.<sup id="cite_ref-540" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-540"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>528<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk has described the release of the files a "distraction", later accusing the <a href="/wiki/Second_presidency_of_Donald_Trump" title="Second presidency of Donald Trump">second Trump administration</a> of suppressing them to protect powerful individuals, including Trump himself.<sup id="cite_ref-544" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-544"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>m<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Wealth">Wealth</h2></div>
<div class="excerpt-block"><style data-mw-deduplicate="TemplateStyles:r1353838603">.mw-parser-output .excerpt-hat .mw-editsection-like{font-style:normal}</style><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable dablink excerpt-hat selfref">These paragraphs are an excerpt from <a href="/wiki/Wealth_of_Elon_Musk" title="Wealth of Elon Musk">Wealth of Elon Musk</a>.<span class="mw-editsection-like plainlinks"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a class="external text" data-mw-original-href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wealth_of_Elon_Musk&action=edit" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wealth_of_Elon_Musk&action=edit">edit</a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div><div class="excerpt">
<p>Elon Musk is the wealthiest person in the world that’s been verified, with an estimated <a href="/wiki/Net_worth" title="Net worth">net worth</a> of US$659 billion as of May 2026<sup class="plainlinks noexcerpt noprint asof-tag update" style="display:none;"><a class="external text" data-mw-original-href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Elon_Musk&action=edit" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Elon_Musk&action=edit">[update]</a></sup>, according to the <i><a href="/wiki/Bloomberg_Billionaires_Index" title="Bloomberg Billionaires Index">Bloomberg Billionaires Index</a></i>,<sup id="cite_ref-545" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-545"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>532<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and $788 billion according to <i><a href="/wiki/Forbes" title="Forbes">Forbes</a></i>,<sup id="cite_ref-546" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-546"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>533<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> primarily from his ownership stakes in <a href="/wiki/SpaceX" title="SpaceX">SpaceX</a> and <a href="/wiki/Tesla,_Inc." title="Tesla, Inc.">Tesla</a>.
</p><p>Having been first listed on the <a href="/wiki/The_World%27s_Billionaires" title="The World's Billionaires"><i>Forbes Billionaires List</i></a> in 2012,<sup id="cite_ref-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_:1_547-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_:1-547"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>534<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> around 75% of Musk's wealth was derived from Tesla stock in November 2020,<sup id="cite_ref-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_gates_548-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_gates-548"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>535<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> although he describes himself as "<a href="https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cash_poor" class="extiw" title="wikt:cash poor">cash poor</a>".<sup id="cite_ref-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_cash_549-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_cash-549"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>536<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_wsj_550-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_wsj-550"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>537<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> According to <i>Forbes</i>, he became the first person in the world to achieve a net worth of $300 billion in 2021; $400 billion in December 2024;<sup id="cite_ref-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_maruf_551-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_maruf-551"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>538<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> $500 billion in October 2025;<sup id="cite_ref-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_Elon_$500M_Forbes_552-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_Elon_$500M_Forbes-552"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>539<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> $600 billion in mid-December 2025;<sup id="cite_ref-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_$600B_553-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_$600B-553"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>540<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> $700 billion later that month;<sup id="cite_ref-554" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-554"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>541<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and $800 billion in February 2026.<sup id="cite_ref-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_$800B_555-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_$800B-555"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>542<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In November 2025, a Tesla pay package worth potentially $1 trillion for Musk was approved, which he is to receive over 10 years if he meets specific goals.<sup id="cite_ref-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_$1_trillion_package_approved_556-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Wealth_of_Elon_Musk_$1_trillion_package_approved-556"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>543<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
</div></div>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Musk_Foundation">Musk Foundation</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <a href="/wiki/Musk_Foundation" title="Musk Foundation">Musk Foundation</a></div>
<p>The Musk Foundation is a United States–based charitable <a href="/wiki/Foundation_(nonprofit)" title="Foundation (nonprofit)">foundation</a> funded and directed primarily by Musk. The foundation is dedicated to promoting <a href="/wiki/Renewable_energy" title="Renewable energy">renewable energy</a>, <a href="/wiki/Space_exploration" title="Space exploration">crewed space exploration</a>, <a href="/wiki/Pediatrics" title="Pediatrics">pediatrics</a>, science and engineering education, and the "development of safe <a href="/wiki/Artificial_intelligence" title="Artificial intelligence">artificial intelligence</a> for the benefit of humanity".<sup id="cite_ref-secretive_foundation_557-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-secretive_foundation-557"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>544<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>At the end of 2024, the Musk Foundation had over $14 billion in assets. Since 2020, donations have largely been sent to organizations affiliated with Musk and his businesses.<sup id="cite_ref-558" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-558"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>545<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Public_image">Public image</h2></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <a href="/wiki/Public_image_of_Elon_Musk" title="Public image of Elon Musk">Public image of Elon Musk</a></div>
<p>Although his ventures have been highly influential within their separate industries starting in the 2000s, Musk only became a public figure in the early 2010s. He has been described as an eccentric who makes spontaneous and impactful decisions, while also often making controversial statements, contrary to other billionaires who prefer reclusiveness to protect their businesses. Musk's actions and <a href="/wiki/Views_of_Elon_Musk" title="Views of Elon Musk">his expressed views</a> have made him a polarizing figure.<sup id="cite_ref-Trouble_559-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Trouble-559"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>546<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Biographer <a href="/wiki/Ashlee_Vance" title="Ashlee Vance">Ashlee Vance</a> described people's opinions of Musk as polarized due to his "part philosopher, part <a href="/wiki/Troll_(slang)" class="mw-redirect" title="Troll (slang)">troll</a>" persona on Twitter.<sup id="cite_ref-celebrity_560-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-celebrity-560"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>547<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> He has drawn denouncement for using his platform to mock the self-selection of <a href="/wiki/Preferred_gender_pronoun" title="Preferred gender pronoun">personal pronouns</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-561" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-561"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>548<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> while also receiving praise for bringing international attention to matters like <a href="/wiki/British_people" title="British people">British</a> survivors of <a href="/wiki/Grooming_gangs_scandal" title="Grooming gangs scandal">grooming gangs</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-562" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-562"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>549<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Musk has been described as an American <a href="/wiki/Oligarchy" title="Oligarchy">oligarch</a> due to his extensive influence over public discourse, social media, industry, politics, and government policy.<sup id="cite_ref-563" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-563"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>550<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> After Trump's re-election, Musk's <a href="/wiki/Political_activities_of_Elon_Musk#United_States" title="Political activities of Elon Musk">influence and actions</a> during the transition period and the <a href="/wiki/Second_presidency_of_Donald_Trump" title="Second presidency of Donald Trump">second presidency of Donald Trump</a> led some to call him "President Musk", the "actual president-elect", "shadow president" or "co-president".<sup id="cite_ref-564" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-564"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>551<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-565" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-565"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>552<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Accolades">Accolades</h3></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1353705441"><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <a href="/wiki/List_of_awards_and_honors_received_by_Elon_Musk" title="List of awards and honors received by Elon Musk">List of awards and honors received by Elon Musk</a></div>
<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/wiki/File:Conectividade_e_Prote%C3%A7%C3%A3o_da_Amaz%C3%B4nia_com_Elon_Musk_-_52089866211.png" class="mw-file-description"><img alt="Musk wearing a medal" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/9a/Conectividade_e_Prote%C3%A7%C3%A3o_da_Amaz%C3%B4nia_com_Elon_Musk_-_52089866211.png/250px-Conectividade_e_Prote%C3%A7%C3%A3o_da_Amaz%C3%B4nia_com_Elon_Musk_-_52089866211.png" decoding="async" width="250" height="445" style="--mw-file-upright: .6" class="mw-file-element mw-file-upright" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/9a/Conectividade_e_Prote%C3%A7%C3%A3o_da_Amaz%C3%B4nia_com_Elon_Musk_-_52089866211.png/330px-Conectividade_e_Prote%C3%A7%C3%A3o_da_Amaz%C3%B4nia_com_Elon_Musk_-_52089866211.png 2x" data-file-width="3776" data-file-height="6720"></a><figcaption>Musk receiving the <a href="/wiki/Order_of_Defence_Merit" title="Order of Defence Merit">Order of Defence Merit</a> from the <a href="/wiki/Brazilian_Armed_Forces" title="Brazilian Armed Forces">Brazilian Armed Forces</a> in 2022<sup id="cite_ref-Costa2022_566-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Costa2022-566"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>553<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></figcaption></figure>
<p>Awards for his contributions to the development of the <a href="/wiki/Falcon_rocket" class="mw-redirect" title="Falcon rocket">Falcon rockets</a> include the <a href="/wiki/American_Institute_of_Aeronautics_and_Astronautics" title="American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics">American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics</a> George Low Transportation Award in 2008,<sup id="cite_ref-567" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-567"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>554<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> the <span title="French-language text"><span lang="fr" style="font-style: normal;"><a href="/wiki/F%C3%A9d%C3%A9ration_A%C3%A9ronautique_Internationale" title="Fédération Aéronautique Internationale">Fédération Aéronautique Internationale</a></span></span> Gold Space Medal in 2010,<sup id="cite_ref-568" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-568"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>555<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and the <a href="/wiki/Royal_Aeronautical_Society" title="Royal Aeronautical Society">Royal Aeronautical Society</a> Gold Medal in 2012.<sup id="cite_ref-569" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-569"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>556<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2015, he received an honorary doctorate in engineering and technology from <a href="/wiki/Yale_University" title="Yale University">Yale University</a><sup id="cite_ref-570" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-570"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>557<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and an <a href="/wiki/IEEE_Honorary_Membership" title="IEEE Honorary Membership">Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers Honorary Membership</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-571" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-571"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>558<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk was elected a <a href="/wiki/Fellow_of_the_Royal_Society" title="Fellow of the Royal Society">Fellow of the Royal Society</a> (FRS) in 2018.<sup id="cite_ref-572" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-572"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>559<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-574" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-574"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>n<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In 2022, Musk was elected to the <a href="/wiki/National_Academy_of_Engineering" title="National Academy of Engineering">National Academy of Engineering</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-lat20141214_575-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-lat20141214-575"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>561<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p><i><a href="/wiki/Time_(magazine)" title="Time (magazine)">Time</a></i> has listed Musk as <a href="/wiki/Time_100" title="Time 100">one of the most influential people in the world</a> in 2010,<sup id="cite_ref-576" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-576"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>562<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> 2013,<sup id="cite_ref-577" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-577"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>563<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> 2018,<sup id="cite_ref-578" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-578"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>564<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and 2021.<sup id="cite_ref-579" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-579"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>565<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Musk was selected as <i>Time</i><span class="nowrap" style="padding-left:0.1em;">'</span>s "<a href="/wiki/Time_Person_of_the_Year" title="Time Person of the Year">Person of the Year</a>" for 2021. Then <i>Time</i> editor-in-chief <a href="/wiki/Edward_Felsenthal" title="Edward Felsenthal">Edward Felsenthal</a> wrote that, "Person of the Year is a marker of influence, and few individuals have had more influence than Musk on life on Earth, and potentially life off Earth too."<sup id="cite_ref-580" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-580"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>566<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-581" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-581"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>567<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
